name: Path of the Gods (Sentiero degli Dei)
why: A balcony path 500 m above the sea, from Agerola's terraces to Positano, with the whole Amalfi Coast and Capri ahead.
book: No ticket. SITA bus to Bomerano (Agerola) from Amalfi; at Nocelle take the local bus down to Positano or the 1,700 steps.
water: Fill up in Bomerano; a fountain and kiosks only in Nocelle.
dangers: Little shade: in summer start by 8:30 and carry sun protection.
Uneven limestone steps, slippery after rain; no barrier on some drops.
turnaround: If you reach Colle Serra after 12:00 in summer, drop to Praiano instead of going on.

points.name: Bomerano, Agerola
points.note: Start at Piazza Paolo Capasso; signs for path 327 lead down past terraces and the Grotta del Biscotto.

points.name: Colle Serra above Praiano
points.note: The path crests above Praiano: Positano, Li Galli and Capri appear ahead.

points.name: Nocelle above Positano
points.note: A car-free hamlet 450 m above Positano. Bus or 1,700 steps down to the town.
